proposals.text:
Thanks — I can’t find a tool in my set that returns the card’s last 4 digits from the account ID. Because our dispute filing tool requires the card last-4, I’m unable to file the dispute until you provide those four digits.

Options (pick one):
1) You provide the card’s last 4 digits (safe to share here). I’ll file the dispute immediately after you send them.  
2) Look them up in the Rho-Bank mobile app or your paper/electronic statement and paste the last 4 here. (How to find them in the app: open the app → Cards → select Silver Rewards Card (cc_890389b165_silver) → Card details or Recent statement; the last 4 are shown there.)  
3) If you’d prefer, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to access card metadata on your behalf — tell me if you want me to transfer and I’ll do that.

Notes:
- You don’t need to send the full card number — only the last 4 digits.  
- We’ll file this as dispute_reason = goods_services_not_as_described, contacted_merchant = true, discovery_date = 11/14/2025, resolution_requested = full_refund, and I’ll attach your booking confirmation when you provide it.

Which option would you like?
